we developed a method for extracting radiosensitivity coefficients from pre‐therapy PET imaging data and that these radiosensitivity coefficients can be used to stratify patients for dose painting and to identify potential biological treatment planning targets.

the extraction of voxel‐ based radiosensitivity coefficients from PET data using a tumor simulation model.
the development and validation of a computational model that extracts voxel‐based radiosensitivities from multiparametric imaging data.
